crossRefs.note: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

translations.web: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.
translations.bsb: The special portion you set apart to the LORD shall be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.
translations.kjv: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
translations.asv: The oblation that ye shall offer unto Jehovah shall be five and twenty thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in breadth.
